Vault42 is running. The dashboard is not in this binary.

The HTTP API is unaffected and fully available. Only the embedded web dashboard is missing, because the single-page app was not built before this binary was compiled.

This is expected for go install, which cannot run a frontend build.

To get a binary with the dashboard, build the frontend first:

scripts/build-all.sh

Or use a published container image, where the dashboard is always built in: ghcr.io/42-v/vault42.

Health check: /healthz. Key set: /.well-known/jwks.json.
